info.description:
The control plane manages forms and immutable schema versions. The public
data plane exposes published schemas and accepts validated submissions.
Schema and submission JSON numbers preserve exact numeric values. Clients
must not round numbers through binary floating point before sending them or
after reading them. Numeric tokens are limited to 4096 bytes, explicit
exponents to -1024 through 1024, and expanded values to 1024 integer and
1024 fractional decimal places. Excessive numeric representations return
400 rather than being rounded. JSONB may normalize numeric notation;
numerically equivalent retries remain idempotent.

200.description:
Submissions for the owned, non-deleted form, ordered by received time
and ID descending. Reuse the same filters with nextCursor; pagination
is not a snapshot of future inserts. Only the documented parameters
are supported; unknown, repeated, and invalid filters return 400.
The encoded query is limited to 4096 bytes.
Payloads require submissions:read, not merely forms:read.

200.description: Organization-owned submission with redacted data and the exact accepted schema, not the current form schema. Unresolvable or invalid privacy policy fails closed.

post.description: The caller may delegate only scopes already present in its authenticated principal. This operation is intentionally not retryable because GoFormX cannot recover a stored token secret.

201.description: Token issued; the response is Cache-Control no-store and plaintext is never recoverable

delete.summary: Revoke one service token owned by the authenticated organization

200.description: Published schema; omitted version resolves to current

post.summary: Submit data to a published form

data.description: Validated against the selected published form schema. Must be an object, not null or absent. For nonempty x-goformx-sensitive policies, validation failures return one generic /data diagnostic because messages and instance locations can contain sensitive values.

data.name: Ada Lovelace
data.message: I would like to discuss a project.

202.description: Submission validated, persisted, and accepted for processing. Returned data is redacted using the accepted schema policy; stored data and configured webhook delivery are unchanged. Responses use Cache-Control no-store.

429.description: Per-form burst or rolling submission budget exceeded

serviceToken.description: External integration credential stored server-side, returned once, and verified by hash, organization owner, lifecycle, and required operation scope. Browsers must not receive it.

firstPartyAssertion.description: Single-use, at-most-60-second assertion minted by the Waaseyaa server after session authentication and organization membership resolution. Never delivered to a browser and never accepted as an external service token.

SubmissionReceivedFrom.name: receivedFrom
SubmissionReceivedFrom.description: Inclusive submittedAt lower bound, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset and at most microsecond precision. Indexed with formId.

SubmissionReceivedBefore.name: receivedBefore
SubmissionReceivedBefore.description: Exclusive submittedAt upper bound, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset and at most microsecond precision. Must be later than receivedFrom when both are present.

SubmissionStatusFilter.name: status
SubmissionStatusFilter.description: Accepted payloads are immutable; webhook delivery progress is a separate resource, not a submission status transition.

SubmissionSchemaVersionFilter.name: schemaVersion
SubmissionSchemaVersionFilter.description: Exact schema version used at acceptance; indexed with formId and submittedAt. Not the form's current published version.

PublicKey.name: publicKey
PublicKey.description: Rotatable, non-secret identifier safe for browser embeds.

SchemaVersionHeader.name: X-GoFormX-Schema-Version
SchemaVersionHeader.description: Pins validation to a published version; omitted means current.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Public submission retries with the same form key and body return the original result.

SubmissionLimit.name: limit
SubmissionLimit.description: Maximum submissions returned in this page.

PageLimit.name: limit
PageLimit.description: Maximum resources returned in this bounded collection.

PageOffset.name: offset
PageOffset.description: Zero-based form collection offset; bounded to prevent unbounded scans.

FormQuery.name: q
FormQuery.description: Case-insensitive literal substring search over form name and title.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact strong ETag returned by the latest form GET or successful mutation.

SubmissionCursor.name: cursor
SubmissionCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as meta.nextCursor by the previous page.

FormDefinition.description: A JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 object conforming to the canonical linked schema.

allowedOrigins.description: Stored browser-origin allowlist. An empty array grants no cross-origin browser access; it is never a wildcard.

requestId.description: Correlation identifier for the accepted public request; it contains no credential or payload data.

status.description: Immutable acceptance state. Delivery attempts have their own lifecycle.

data.description: Redacted projection of the immutable payload. Marked object members are omitted, marked array elements are null, and a root pointer yields an empty object. Never use this projection for validation or resubmission.

redactedPaths.description: Sorted JSON Pointers declared sensitive by the accepted schema, including absent optional targets. Empty when no fields are marked. Values are never returned via a reveal flag.

url.description: Public HTTPS destination on port 443, without credentials, query, or fragment.

origin.description: Destination origin only; the encrypted path is never returned.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the request document

Error.description: Stable error envelope; status is determined by the HTTP response code

ValidationError.description: The request or submission failed schema validation

error.message: Submission does not match schema version 3.

fields.message: Must be a valid email address.

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match is required for this mutation

PreconditionFailed.description: The supplied form validator is stale
